note: Hover robot, 3 rigid parts cut by connected component (no bisect plane, no cap): Body = every component that is not a lower leg (head, vanes, arms with their hanging rear pieces, core shell remnants), LowerLeg_L / LowerLeg_R = the two front legs, the two separate components x 13..63 cm, y +-(25..76), z 1..62. The mesh also has two rear hanging pieces (x -46..-10, z 0..56) fused to the arm components: they stay in Body. Pivot = inner top of the leg under the yellow pad where the leg stub meets the shell; body pivot = world origin (actor ground point, the C++ hover bob moves the whole actor). PartId = (index + 0.5) / 10 with the same index layout and texture layout (20 columns, texel 2i = quaternion, 2i+1 = translation) as the other robots; columns of unused indices stay identity.
